item.title: IDA Member Spotlight: Joshua Seftel
item.description: Welcome to IDA Member Spotlight, a monthly interview series highlighting IDA members and showcasing the depth and diversity of our community. This month, we had the pleasure of speaking with Joshua Seftel.Joshua Seftel is an Oscar-nominated and Emmy-winning director driven by the conviction that storytelling can promote empathy, connection, and change. That thread can be seen throughout his work, going back over 35 years.

item.title: Filmmaker and Director Raoul Peck Reflects on the "Decay of Truth"
item.description: Late last year, IDA gathered documentary field leaders and friends, along with our Impact Circle community, at a private home in New York City for an intimate conversation about the state of our field. Raoul Peck spoke.

item.description: The following Glossary and Key Takeaways, organized as answers to 5 specific questions, were collected from the February 5 IDAinsight titled “Beyond the Distributor: Theatrical Exhibition for Independently-Released Films.”

item.title: Jonathan Gray, Susan Margolin, Jennifer Tiexiera and Katie Townsend Join IDA Board of Directors
item.description: IDA announced that Jonathan Gray, attorney and producer, Susan Margolin, producer and a pioneer of digital distribution, Jennifer Tiexiera, filmmaker and co-founder of co-founders of Lady & Bird, and Katie Townsend, litigator and previous Deputy Executive Director & Legal Director of the Reporters Committee for Freedom of the Press, have joined its board.

item.title: Defend Documentary's Place in Greek Public Media
item.description: The Hellenic Documentary Association (Hellas Docs) has asked IDA to add our voice to their "Culture Absent" initiative, and we are glad to do so.This week, IDA joined European documentary organizations at the Thessaloniki Documentary Festival to build stronger, more coordinated support for filmmakers around the world. The need for public investment in documentary — from broadcaster funding to institutional support — was a part of those conversations.
